title: Ask HN: How can I tell articles on HN is AI written or not?
excerpt: For most it's quite easy with all the crappy AI style marks. Read a few people complain are AI to get a feel, then you can recognize it in less subtle ones.
content_html:
For most it's quite easy with all the crappy AI style marks. Read a few people complain are AI to get a feel, then you can recognize it in less subtle ones.

In short comments / casual threads, it's not so easy. It can 100% look like a human comment with no special marks. Having been trained to billions of Twitter, Reddit and other messages, and the short text span, makes it difficult.

If it's so good it's not recognizable, well, not much you can do.

content_html_zh:
对于大多数人来说，有了所有蹩脚的人工智能风格标记，这很容易。 读一些人抱怨人工智能的文章来感受一下，然后你就可以在不那么微妙的情况下识别它。

在简短的评论/随意的线程中，这并不容易。 它可以 100% 看起来像人类评论，没有特殊标记。 由于接受过数十亿条 Twitter、Reddit 和其他消息的训练，而且文本跨度短，这使得这变得很困难。

如果它太好了，那就认不出来了，好吧，你无能为力。
